in_sanskrit.name: देविन्दर
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of Indra or Lord Indra
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the God (Deva) of Indra (Indra) and is the Lord (Isha) over him.

in_hindi.name: देविन्दर
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (God) के राजा (King) या ईश्वर (Lord) हुवा इंद्र (Indra) के लिए हैं

in_marathi.name: Devindar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devindar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Devindar is derived from Sanskrit words ‘deva’ (god) and ‘indra’ (Thunderbolt). This name is given to a boy, signifying the divine power and strength of the deity Indra, the god of rain and thunder.
